title: Never Face The WALL At Grandma's 🛏️
description:
Every bed in my grandma's house is pushed against a wall, and our family has one rule: never sleep facing it, or something sits on your bed.

I've slept there every Christmas for twenty-six years and never broken it. This year I drove up with my whole apartment in my car, and on the first night I turned over.

It's made up. A blocky story, built with code and Blender.
pin: Comment WALL if you sleep facing it.
